draftyak.entities.ChatMessage.description: A chat message with the provider's user or bot id, never a display name. A deleted message keeps its row with deleted set.

draftyak.entities.MessageDirection.description: Derived by the hub, never taken from a plugin. outbound needs the hub's own evidence: a send it verified, SENT mail it parsed, or on chat the owner's user id from its own auth check; on a device-hosted channel, a row the host reports as sent, which stays device-asserted. Every other message is inbound, including mail not parsed yet, mail without a single From, and mail from the owner's address without that evidence. So a message the hub can't place can only hold a send: an inbound message newer than a scheduled item's inbound watermark holds it under hold-if-reply, and being inbound grants nothing, neither known-contact status nor a verified sender.

draftyak.entities.Conversation.description: A thread or chat. workspaceId and assigneeUserId stay null for a single owner; archived and read are the hub's own state where the channel has no provider organize.

draftyak.entities.Device.description: A paired device. spkiSha256 pins its transport certificate's key; approvalKey verifies its statements. confirmedEpoch is the hub epoch at which an approver confirmed it, or null: a device confirmed before the current epoch counts as unconfirmed.

draftyak.pairing.DisplayName.description: A display name: 1 to 64 code points under the rules of spec/pairing-v1.md section 2: no hidden code point, no blank first or last, and at least one code point that is neither a blank nor a joiner. JSON Schema can't state the rules, only the length.

draftyak.entities.PublicKeySpki.description: A P-256 public key as canonical base64url of its 91-byte SPKI DER, uncompressed point.

draftyak.entities.KeyClass.description: Where the device keeps its keys: keyring is the platform's credential store; dev is a test key that release builds refuse.

draftyak.entities.DeviceCapabilities.description: A device's capabilities, each once. A host:* capability is exclusive: a device that holds one holds nothing else.

draftyak.entities.DeviceCapability.description: What a paired device may do.

draftyak.entities.DmarcResult.description: DMARC from the topmost Authentication-Results whose authserv-id is the provider's own; any other result, or none, reads none.

Header text is the message's, cut to its bound, and mailboxes as Mailbox reads them; only dmarc and direction are the hub's own findings. The body is fetched apart.

draftyak.entities.Message.description: A synced message. Every text field from it is untrusted; direction is the hub's, and provenance names what delivered it.

draftyak.entities.OutboxItem.description: A frozen send proposal of a draft revision. contentHash and flagsHash cover its snapshot and the flags the owner saw; notBefore and deliverBy bound when it may send, and requiredApprovals counts the approvals it needs.

draftyak.entities.ProposedBy.description: The owner (a user id) or an agent (a grant or agent token id); an agent can cancel only what it proposed.

draftyak.entities.StateReason.description: Why an item needs approval again; the UI labels it from this, as Missed.

draftyak.entities.OutboxState.description: An outbox item's state. APPROVED, SCHEDULED, SENDING, RETRY_WAIT and UNKNOWN are live: while a draft has a live item, it is locked.

draftyak.entities.OwnerSettings.description: The owner's time zone, which schedules and lookups use, and working hours.

draftyak.tool-v1.IanaZone.description: An IANA time zone name, such as America/Chicago; Temporal checks that it exists.

draftyak.entities.WorkingHours.description: The owner's working days and hours, HH:mm in their zone, start before end; the default is mon to fri, 09:00 to 17:00.

draftyak.entities.RoutingDestination.description: Where account data may go: local (loopback) by default; every other destination is opted into per account. cloud-tool is for tool instances only.

draftyak.entities.ToolDestination.description: local: no egress or loopback only; local-network: RFC 1918 or ULA addresses; otherwise cloud-tool.
